_comment: Settings for start_class.bat / start_class.ps1. Safe to commit -- no secrets live here (those go in .spotify_auth.json, which is gitignored). Any value can be overridden on the command line, e.g. start_class.bat -Deck 1D_flow -BellTime 14:05
_playlist_help: Either a Spotify URI (spotify:playlist:ID) or a pasted share link (https://open.spotify.com/playlist/ID?si=...) works -- the script normalizes it.
